name: Uncategorized — 1 Level 1 — Eye of the Translator

system.description:
A ritual of limited physical power but mighty practical use: it assists the sorcerer in deciphering any written material upon which it is cast. Many viziers learn the basics of Assamite Sorcery for this ritual alone. It does not alter the page, but creates an illusion of the writing flowing into a form the caster can read.

The sorcerer cuts himself along the left eyebrow and lets three drops of blood (no Blood Trait cost) fall upon the page, then meditates for 10 minutes while the blood soaks in and vanishes. The number of successes on the casting challenge grants that many bonus Traits on all challenges to translate, decode, or comprehend the affected work. These bonus Traits are lost if the character breaks off work for more than 10 minutes, or at end of night. The ritual must be recast separately for each page or surface to be translated.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
system.bloodCost: None (three drops of blood, no Blood Trait cost)
